Keystone

Keeps a house running: every system with its age and replacement year, a 10-year savings plan, the maintenance calendar, records and warranties, step-by-step diagnosis and local pros, with a platform for the contractors who serve the homeowners.

Visit the site ↗How to useIn motion

01

Problem

Most owners learn how their house works when something breaks. The water heater's age is on a label in the basement, warranties are lost in email, and the big replacements (roof, furnace, air conditioner) often arrive within a few years of each other with no money set aside. The contractor who does the work keeps separate notes, so the history of the house leaves with each job.

02

What it does

Keystone Home lists every system and component with its install year, life stage and the year to plan its replacement, then turns them into a 10-year capital plan with inflation, a monthly savings target and a preparedness score. It builds the maintenance calendar from those systems, keeps records, documents, warranties and a home inventory, and prints a home history report, an insurance loss packet and a transfer file for a buyer. A Home Health Snapshot of 15 questions gives a score out of 100 and the tasks to fix it. Diagnose walks through 36 common problems, safety question first, then sends a request to pros who serve the ZIP code. Keystone Pro gives those contractors a day briefing, leads, quotes, a schedule, a job record with before and after photos, estimates and invoices; a finished job is written into the homeowner's history. Keystone Parts finds a part by model number, part number or problem and links to Amazon. The book Inside Your House explains each system, and every chapter links to the matching page of the app.

03

How it is built

React and TypeScript, one app for the homeowner side, the contractor side, the parts finder and the book, hosted on Vercel. Each account keeps a copy of its data in the browser and syncs it with Supabase every 15 seconds, so the app keeps working offline. Row level security keeps each household's records private; the steps that involve both sides (accepting a quote, finishing a job, paying an invoice) run on the server. Lifespans and costs are national planning estimates. Pros never pay to rank. Parts links carry an Amazon Associates tag, and the site shows no Amazon prices or photos.
